annotations.title: The commitment tape: who committed to which fund, when, in the plan's own words

description: Public plans' own commitment disclosures, one row per line: plan, fund as printed, manager, amount, status, dates, vintage, re-up, the plan's own performance figures and the source document with a quote. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.
